title: A session whose live hooks lag origin/main says so in one line at start and resume
why: Lane notes-fix-large-1 (session_013NEJL4DPEKRiC91yHkQV7m), 15:25 CST Nov 9: in its cloud container /root/.claude/hooks/guard.py dated from Nov 7 20:03 UTC, when the pointer checkout went to 174b005c1. It lacked the test-author merge route (d0a2a4860, Nov 7 21:21 UTC), so an act owner item 420 a allows (step mixed-merge-resolver) was refused with "No override lifts this refusal". Two days of rulings were not in force, and nothing said so.
note: Sighting 1. Fix to find: at session start and resume, compare the live hook copy's source commit with origin/main and name the lag in one line (the session_start.sh header already warns when global rules differ from the checkout; extend that home). Related: pointer-move-unseen (doing, #2458; the pointer move is this lag's cause here) and cloud-install-from-main (done). Lane, 15:28 CST Nov 9: after its compaction resume, /root/.claude/hooks/guard.py still had mtime 2026-11-07 20:03:28 UTC and 0 hits for merge_route_paths. So a compact resume did not reinstall hooks there (this triage session's resume did reinstall from main at 624dcc188; the difference is unmeasured).
